A fix for a public address answered by IPv6, claude.com in the AI preset, and a missing line in the UDP guard's log.

To update, run the new `dpiswitch.exe` from anywhere and accept the offer to install over the installed version (one administrator prompt). Settings, lists, configs and verdicts are kept.

## Detector and routes

- **A public address of the other family is no change.** RIPE answers by whichever of its addresses the direct path reached first, and on a network with IPv6 direct the address went from IPv4 to IPv6 and back: the ISP was looked up again each time, and a lookup failing then would have put the gateway's memory in place of the ISP's -- every name off its direct verdict until the next one. An address is compared with the known one of its own family only.

## Presets

- **The AI preset is one list, and claude.com is in it.** claude.com, Anthropic's own address now, was in the preset nowhere: checked as any name, it came out blocked by address and went by the first tunnel. It goes by the second one now, as the rest of Anthropic. The preset's two files -- names behind the SNI proxy and Google's AI -- went by the second tunnel alike, and are one.

## UDP leak guard

- After a sleep the guard goes in before Wi-Fi is up; the line saying its check waits for an adapter was never written, and is now.

Core: the fork's 8067c742 (mihomo Alpha 9f053c49).
